```{r sample-summary}
expected_n <- 32

make_id_summary <- function(data, subset_name, expected_n = 32) {
  present_n <- dplyr::n_distinct(data$participant_id, na.rm = TRUE)
  missing_rows <- sum(is.na(data$participant_id))
  
  tibble::tibble(
    subset = subset_name,
    n_rows = nrow(data),
    expected_n = expected_n,
    present_n = present_n,
    missing_n = expected_n - present_n,
    missing_rows = missing_rows,
    prop_missing = missing_rows / nrow(data)
  )
}

id_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  make_id_summary(sub1raw, "sub1", expected_n),
  make_id_summary(sub2raw, "sub2", expected_n),
  make_id_summary(sub3raw, "sub3", expected_n)
)
```

```{r map-participants}
reindex_participants <- function(data) {
  unique_ids <- sort(unique(data$participant_id))
  lookup <- tibble::tibble(
    original_id = unique_ids,
    participant_id_new = sprintf("%02d", seq_along(unique_ids))
  )

  data_reindexed <- data %>%
    left_join(lookup, by = c("participant_id" = "original_id")) %>%
    mutate(participant_id = coalesce(participant_id_new, participant_id)) %>%
    select(-participant_id_new)

  list(data = data_reindexed, lookup = lookup %>% rename(participant_id = participant_id_new))
}

sub1_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub1raw)
sub2_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub2raw)
sub3_reindexed <- reindex_participants(sub3raw)

sub1raw <- sub1_reindexed$data
sub2raw <- sub2_reindexed$data
sub3raw <- sub3_reindexed$data

participant_id_record <- bind_rows(
  mutate(sub1_reindexed$lookup, subset = "Sub1"),
  mutate(sub2_reindexed$lookup, subset = "Sub2"),
  mutate(sub3_reindexed$lookup, subset = "Sub3")
)

cat("Participant ID mapping (original -> new):\n")
print(participant_id_record)
```


```{r prepare-plot-data}
rt_bounds <- c(300, 3000)

parse_resp_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("\\[|\\]", "", as.character(x))))
}

flag_to_bool <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(ifelse(is.na(x), NA, x != 0))
  }
  
  str <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
  str <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", str)
  
  ifelse(
    str %in% c("1", "true", "t", "yes", "y"),
    TRUE,
    ifelse(
      str %in% c("0", "false", "f", "no", "n", ""),
      FALSE,
      NA
    )
  )
}

# Circular stats for directional or axial data
# theta_rad should be in radians on the original scale
# axial = FALSE for full-circle directional data
# axial = TRUE  for 180-degree periodic axial data
circ_stats_safe <- function(theta_rad, axial = FALSE) {
  theta_rad <- theta_rad[!is.na(theta_rad)]
  n <- length(theta_rad)

  if (n == 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        R = NA_real_,
        std_circ = NA_real_,
        std_circ_deg = NA_real_,
        variance = NA_real_,
        SEr = NA_real_,
        SEs = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  theta_work <- if (axial) 2 * theta_rad else theta_rad

  C <- sum(cos(theta_work))
  S <- sum(sin(theta_work))
  R_raw <- sqrt(C^2 + S^2) / n

  if (!is.finite(R_raw)) {
    R_raw <- NA_real_
  }

  R_clamped <- if (is.na(R_raw)) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    min(max(R_raw, .Machine$double.eps), 1)
  }

  std_work <- if (is.na(R_clamped)) NA_real_ else sqrt(-2 * log(R_clamped))

  SEr <- if (is.na(R_raw)) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    sqrt(max(0, 1 - R_raw^2)) / sqrt(n)
  }

  SEs_work <- if (is.na(R_clamped) || R_clamped <= 0) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    (1 / (R_clamped * sqrt(-2 * log(R_clamped)))) * SEr
  }

  divisor <- if (axial) 2 else 1

  std_circ <- if (is.na(std_work)) NA_real_ else std_work / divisor
  std_circ_deg <- if (is.na(std_circ)) NA_real_ else std_circ * (180 / pi)
  variance <- if (is.na(R_raw)) NA_real_ else 1 - R_raw
  SEs <- if (is.na(SEs_work)) NA_real_ else SEs_work / divisor

  tibble::tibble(
    R = R_raw,
    std_circ = std_circ,
    std_circ_deg = std_circ_deg,
    variance = variance,
    SEr = SEr,
    SEs = SEs
  )
}

prepare_subset_for_plots <- function(data, subset_type, rt_bounds) {

  if (!subset_type %in% c("sub1", "sub2", "sub3")) {
    stop("subset_type must be 'sub1', 'sub2', or 'sub3'")
  }

  group_vars <- c("participant_id", "num_items", "cue_type", "duration_ms")
  axial <- subset_type == "sub3"

  mutated <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rt_ms = parse_resp_num(response_RT_from_start),
      precision_deg = parse_resp_num(response_error_deg),
      abs_precision_deg = abs(precision_deg),
      theta_rad = precision_deg * (pi / 180),
      too_fast_flag = flag_to_bool(too_fast_trigger),
      too_slow_flag = flag_to_bool(too_slow_trigger)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fail_missing_pid = is.na(participant_id),
      fail_too_fast = too_fast_flag,
      fail_too_slow = too_slow_flag,
      fail_missing_rt = is.na(rt_ms),
      fail_rt_below = !is.na(rt_ms) & rt_ms < rt_bounds[1],
      fail_rt_above = !is.na(rt_ms) & rt_ms > rt_bounds[2],
      fail_missing_precision = is.na(precision_deg),
      retain_row = !fail_missing_pid &
                   !fail_too_fast &
                   !fail_too_slow &
                   !fail_missing_rt &
                   !fail_rt_below &
                   !fail_rt_above &
                   !fail_missing_precision
    )

  filtered <- mutated %>%
    dplyr::filter(retain_row)

  filtered_trials <- mutated %>%
    dplyr::group_by(participant_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      subset = subset_type,
      n_trials_before = dplyr::n(),
      n_missing_pid_rows = sum(fail_missing_pid, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_too_fast = sum(fail_too_fast, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_too_slow = sum(fail_too_slow, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_rt = sum(fail_missing_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_rt_below = sum(fail_rt_below, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_rt_above = sum(fail_rt_above, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_precision = sum(fail_missing_precision, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_trials_after = sum(retain_row, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_filtered_total = n_trials_before - n_trials_after,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      subset,
      participant_id,
      n_trials_before,
      n_trials_after,
      n_filtered_total,
      n_too_fast,
      n_too_slow,
      n_rt_below,
      n_rt_above,
      n_missing_rt,
      n_missing_precision,
      n_missing_pid_rows
    )

  condition_stats <- filtered %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      circ = list(circ_stats_safe(theta_rad, axial = axial)),
      mean_rt = mean(rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_rt = median(rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
      abs_mean = mean(abs_precision_deg, na.rm = TRUE),
      trials = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest_wider(circ)

  prepared_data <- filtered %>%
    dplyr::left_join(condition_stats, by = group_vars)

  list(
    prepared_data = prepared_data,
    filtered_trials = filtered_trials
  )
}

print_filtered_trials_summary <- function(filtered_trials_df) {
  summary_df <- filtered_trials_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(subset) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      participants = dplyr::n_distinct(participant_id, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_trials_before = sum(n_trials_before, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_trials_after = sum(n_trials_after, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_filtered_total = sum(n_filtered_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_too_fast = sum(n_too_fast, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_too_slow = sum(n_too_slow, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_rt_below = sum(n_rt_below, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_rt_above = sum(n_rt_above, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_rt = sum(n_missing_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_precision = sum(n_missing_precision, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_pid_rows = sum(n_missing_pid_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  print(summary_df)
}

sub1_result <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub1raw, "sub1", rt_bounds)
sub2_result <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub2raw, "sub2", rt_bounds)
sub3_result <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub3raw, "sub3", rt_bounds)

sub1prepared <- sub1_result$prepared_data
sub2prepared <- sub2_result$prepared_data
sub3prepared <- sub3_result$prepared_data

filtered_trials <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  sub1_result$filtered_trials,
  sub2_result$filtered_trials,
  sub3_result$filtered_trials
)

print_filtered_trials_summary(filtered_trials)
```

```{r participant-level-plots}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Helper: make x-axis condition label
# --------------------------------------------------
add_condition_label <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      condition_label = paste0(duration_ms, "ms_", num_items, "item"),
      condition_label = factor(
        condition_label,
        levels = unique(
          paste0(
            sort(unique(duration_ms))[order(sort(unique(duration_ms)))],
            "ms_",
            rep(sort(unique(num_items)), each = 0)
          )
        )
      )
    )
}

# Better explicit ordering helper
make_condition_levels <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    distinct(duration_ms, num_items) %>%
    arrange(duration_ms, num_items) %>%
    mutate(condition_label = paste0(duration_ms, "ms_", num_items, "item")) %>%
    pull(condition_label)
}

prepare_plot_df <- function(df) {
  cond_levels <- make_condition_levels(df)

  df %>%
    mutate(
      condition_label = paste0(duration_ms, "ms_", num_items, "item"),
      condition_label = factor(condition_label, levels = cond_levels),
      cue_type = factor(cue_type)
    )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Precision plot for one participant
# --------------------------------------------------
plot_participant_precision <- function(df, pid, y_max = 180) {
  df_plot <- prepare_plot_df(df) %>%
    filter(participant_id == pid)

  # one row per participant x condition for summary overlay
  df_summary <- df_plot %>%
    distinct(participant_id, cue_type, duration_ms, num_items,
             condition_label, std_circ_deg)

  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = condition_label, y = abs_precision_deg)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.shape = NA,
      width = 0.55
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      alpha = 0.35,
      size = 1.3
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_summary,
      aes(x = condition_label, y = std_circ_deg),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 3,
      shape = 18
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ cue_type, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Participant", pid, "- Conditional Precision"),
      subtitle = "Jittered raw absolute error, boxplots, and conditional circular SD",
      x = "Condition (duration × num_items)",
      y = "Absolute precision error (deg)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# RT plot for one participant
# --------------------------------------------------
plot_participant_rt <- function(df, pid) {
  df_plot <- prepare_plot_df(df) %>%
    filter(participant_id == pid)

  df_summary <- df_plot %>%
    distinct(participant_id, cue_type, duration_ms, num_items,
             condition_label, mean_rt, median_rt)

  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = condition_label, y = rt_ms)) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      alpha = 0.35,
      size = 1.3
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_summary,
      aes(x = condition_label, y = median_rt),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 18,
      size = 3
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df_summary,
      aes(x = condition_label, y = mean_rt),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 17,
      size = 3
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ cue_type, scales = "free_x") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Participant", pid, "- Conditional RT"),
      subtitle = "Jittered raw RT, conditional median RT (diamond), and mean RT (triangle)",
      x = "Condition (duration × num_items)",
      y = "Response time (ms)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r apply-prelim-exclusions}
exclusion_map <- list(
  sub1 = c("08", "18", "24", "25", "29", "30"),
  sub2 = c("01", "10", "12", "22", "29", "30", "31"),
  sub3 = c("14", "20", "21", "28", "31")
)

sub1e1 <- sub1 %>% filter(!participant_id %in% exclusion_map$sub1)
sub2e1 <- sub2 %>% filter(!participant_id %in% exclusion_map$sub2)
sub3e1 <- sub3 %>% filter(!participant_id %in% exclusion_map$sub3)

attr(sub1e1, "subset_key") <- "sub1"
attr(sub2e1, "subset_key") <- "sub2"
attr(sub3e1, "subset_key") <- "sub3"

cat("Applied preliminary exclusions; new counts:",
    "sub1e1 =", nrow(sub1e1),
    "sub2e1 =", nrow(sub2e1),
    "sub3e1 =", nrow(sub3e1), "\n")
```

```{r plot-limits, include=FALSE}
bin_hist_max <- function(values, breaks) {
  values <- values[!is.na(values)]
  if (length(values) == 0) return(0)
  h <- hist(values, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)
  if (length(h$counts) == 0) return(0)
  max(h$counts, na.rm = TRUE)
}

max_bin_per_subset <- function(data, field, breaks) {
  counts <- data %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    summarise(max_bin = bin_hist_max(.data[[field]], breaks), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pull(max_bin)
  if (length(counts) == 0) return(0)
  max(counts, na.rm = TRUE)
}

precision_breaks <- seq(0, 180, by = 5)
precision_xlim <- c(0, 180)
precision_ylim_map <- list(
  sub1 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub1, "abs_precision_deg", precision_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub2 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub2, "abs_precision_deg", precision_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub3 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub3, "abs_precision_deg", precision_breaks), na.rm = TRUE))
)

rt_breaks <- seq(300, 3000, by = 50)
rt_xlim <- c(300, 3000)
rt_ylim_map <- list(
  sub1 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub1, "rt_ms", rt_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub2 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub2, "rt_ms", rt_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub3 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub3, "rt_ms", rt_breaks), na.rm = TRUE))
)

precision_limits_for <- function(data) {
  key <- attr(data, "subset_key")
  if (is.null(key) || !key %in% names(precision_ylim_map)) {
    key <- "sub1"
  }
  list(x = precision_xlim, y = precision_ylim_map[[key]])
}

rt_limits_for <- function(data) {
  key <- attr(data, "subset_key")
  if (is.null(key) || !key %in% names(rt_ylim_map)) {
    key <- "sub1"
  }
  list(x = rt_xlim, y = rt_ylim_map[[key]])
}
```
